title: training_record v1
description:
One (graph, facts, narrative) training example. FROZEN at 1.0.0 in Phase 4.

The SAME schema carries all three corpus tiers. Bronze, Silver and Gold differ only in `tier` and in the `generator` block; every other field means the same thing in all three, and the ten-point validation harness in g2t_aml.corpus.validate gates all three against this document. That is deliberate: a tier-specific schema would let the tiers drift apart in exactly the places a reviewer would want them comparable, and would force a migration the moment Silver landed.

The record is SELF-CONTAINED. `facts` holds the complete case_facts record rather than a pointer to one, so a narrative can always be re-verified against the record it was actually written from, even if the fact store is regenerated later. Verification that reads a *current* fact record rather than the one the narrative was rendered from is not verification, it is a coincidence.

schema_version.description: Frozen. Distinct from facts.schema_version: the training record and the fact record version independently, and both are recorded (invariant 3).

case_id.description: The case this example describes. Equals facts.case_id; a test asserts it.

split.description: Read from the FROZEN Phase 2 split manifest, never recomputed (invariant 2). A record whose split disagrees with the manifest fails validation check 10.

tier.description: Which corpus tier produced the narrative.

facts.description: The complete case_facts record, embedded verbatim. See the title note on self-containment.

graph_ref.description: Repository-relative reference to the case subgraph, as `<case store>#<case_id>`, e.g. `data/processed/amlworld_hi_small/cases#amlworld_hi_small-00036141b3c9b49a`. Resolved by g2t_aml.corpus.graphref, which checks not merely that the store exists but that the referenced subgraph has exactly the node and edge counts `facts.structure` reports. A reference that resolves to a different graph than the facts describe is the failure this field exists to make detectable.

serialised_facts.description: The flat-text serialisation of `facts` (g2t_aml.facts.serialiser, compact style). This is the B7 baseline's input and the fine-tuning prompt's fact block.

target_narrative.description: The narrative itself, plain text. The generation target.

target_slots.description: Character-span alignment from narrative text back to fact fields. Present on every tier: Bronze emits them by construction, Silver carries through the ones its rewrite preserved, Gold has them annotated by hand. They are what makes Phase 10's Layer-2 evaluation an alignment problem rather than an LLM-extraction problem.

field_path.description: Dotted path into the fact record, e.g. `motifs.fan_out.width`. Empty-pathed slots are not permitted: a slot that names no field cannot be checked, and an unbounded slot is exactly what this alignment exists to prevent. Qualitative descriptors instead name their binding's field.

span.description: [start, end) character offsets into target_narrative. `target_narrative[start:end] == rendered_value` is asserted by validation.

rendered_value.description: The text actually written at that span, e.g. `294,203.00 US Dollar`. The claim the checker verifies is PARSED BACK OUT OF THIS STRING, never taken from raw_value — otherwise the round trip would compare the record against itself and prove nothing.

raw_value.description: The value read from the fact record before formatting. Recorded for diagnostics and for measuring rounding error; it is deliberately NOT the value that gets checked.

claim_type.description: Selects the tolerance rule when the slot is turned back into a g2t_aml.facts.checkers.Claim.

generator.description: How this narrative was produced. The only block whose shape differs by tier, and it is open (`additionalProperties: true`) precisely so Silver can record its model and prompt hash, and Gold its annotator id, without a schema bump.

method.description: template -> Bronze, llm_rewrite -> Silver, human -> Gold.

family.description: Template family, e.g. `gather_scatter`. Present for Bronze and for any Silver record whose Bronze source is known.

variant.description: Which surface realisation of the family was used.

renderer_version.description: Version of the code that produced the narrative. Bumped whenever a change alters rendered text, so a corpus can be attributed to an exact renderer.

seed.description: The seed in force. Bronze is deterministic from case_id and does not consult it for variant choice; it is recorded so that is checkable rather than merely claimed.

verification.description: The result of running g2t_aml.facts.checkers over this narrative's own claims, against its own embedded fact record. Written at build time and re-derivable at any point; validation check 4 recomputes it rather than trusting it.

contradicted.description: Must be 0 for a record to pass validation, on every tier.

length.description: Recorded so the length gate is auditable without re-tokenising, and so the tokeniser that measured it is never in doubt.

tokenizer.description: Identifier of the token counter used, e.g. `heuristic-bpe-v1` or `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B`. See DECISIONS D-039.

salience.description: Which salient fields this case requires and which the narrative actually mentions. Phase 6/10 read this; Phase 4 records it so adequacy is measurable without re-deriving the requirement.
